observations.behavior: Adds a new parameter to the Slack notification body: it uses the agent's report if present; otherwise falls back to the default run-completed message.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes how PostHog displays AI-generated reports in Slack notifications. This could help users distinguish between standard completion messages and substantive agent summaries.

observations.behavior: Implements an escaping utility for Slack-compatible Markdown, converting ampersands and angle brackets into HTML entities.
observations.posthog_connection: Protects against malformed or potentially unsafe input when rendering dynamic content from agents or user configuration in Slack posts.

observations.behavior: Adds tests asserting that complete agent messages are preserved at turn boundaries rather than being treated as partial chunks.
observations.posthog_connection: Clarifies expected behavior of the FinalMessageTracker component, supporting reliable aggregation of multi-part responses before delivery.

observations.limitations: Only three hunks were examined despite several other changes; no tier elevation is warranted without broader context on systemic impact.

review.limitations: Only three hunks were examined despite several other changes; no tier elevation is warranted without broader context on systemic impact.
review.reason: The patch demonstrates a bounded capability improvement: extending Slack notifications with optional agent reports while adding necessary escaping and corresponding unit tests. The implementation and checks are visible, but there is no evidence of broader architectural change or risk reduction across multiple components.
review.posthog_relevance: Relevant to PostHog's AI workflow execution and notification subsystems, particularly where users rely on clear distinction between routine status updates and substantive agent-generated summaries.
review.uncertainty: Assessment relies solely on this chunk; adoption and actual benefit remain unverified.
